_comment: What a node's manifest may name besides ports (spec 019): its category and the types of its params. The engine checks every manifest against this file (oneframe/vocabulary.py) and keeps no list of its own, so a category added here needs no engine edit; a param type also needs its check (oneframe/manifest.py's check_param) and its control in the page (app/renderer/form.js), which tests hold. Devices are not here: the engine branches on them, so they are named once in code (oneframe/node/devices.py).

source.doc: Brings something in: a photo, clicks, text.

depth.doc: One image to depth, points, camera, normals.

object.doc: One image, or a cut-out, to a mesh or splat of one object.

reconstruct.doc: Views to cameras, points, splats or meshes.

render.doc: An asset to images along a camera path.

sound.doc: Makes or changes sound: an ambient loop, an object's own sounds.

convert.doc: Changes a value's facets or form without a model. The one category the engine reads: a convert node with one input and one output is a converter the plan may insert (oneframe/registry.py).

export.doc: Writes a file for another program.

int.doc: A whole number, with an optional min and max.

float.doc: A number, with an optional min and max.

file.doc: A file the person picked, by its import's id (the sha256 of its content), never a path.

json.doc: A JSON object held to the shape of the port type its `of` names (spec 020): clicks, a camera.
